title: Warm GP: when does it stop shrinking?
topic: Bench data on how long heated gutta-percha keeps shrinking: minutes while cooling, up to 10 h at 37 °C, no data found past 24 h.

claims.claim: Cooling: 1.0–2.3 % linear shrinkage in 10 min, 75→37 °C, in vitro (3 backfill GP brands, tabletop device)
claims.source: Lottanti S, Tauböck TT, Zehnder M, J Endod 2014;40:721-4 (PMID 24767571; abstract)

claims.claim: Held at 37 °C: keeps shrinking for 45 min–10 h, in vitro (4 thermosensitive GP products, dilatometer; clock start not defined in the abstract)
claims.source: Lee CQ et al., J Endod 1997;23:579-82 (PMID 9587286; abstract)

claims.claim: Stamp CRYSTALLIZING = inferred mechanism label (Lee's abstract names no mechanism)
claims.source: Inferred from Grassi MD et al., J Endod 1989;15:517-21 (PMID 2639948; abstract: isothermal shrinkage during crystallization) and Schilder H et al., Oral Surg Oral Med Oral Pathol 1985;59:285-96 (PMID 3856822; abstract)

claims.claim: Then stable to 24 h (end of the 24-h hold), in vitro
claims.source: Lee CQ et al., J Endod 1997;23:579-82 (PMID 9587286; abstract)

claims.claim: After 24 h: no data found for heated GP
claims.source: Literature search, no study found (RESEARCH.md L4); not a claim that it was never measured

claims.claim: Compact it warm (in vitro): vertical compaction of warm GP more than compensated for shrinkage on cooling
claims.source: Marlin J, MSD thesis, Boston University 1971 (thesis abstract only; published as Marlin J, Schilder H, Oral Surg Oral Med Oral Pathol 1973;36:872-9, PMID 4524837, paper not read)

claims.claim: Use sealer (in vitro): GP without sealer leaked more than GP + sealer at 48 h
claims.source: Wu MK, Fan B, Wesselink PR, Int Endod J 2000;33:121-5 (PMID 11307452; abstract)

claims.claim: Curves, temperature trace, time axis and canal view are schematic
claims.source: Toy model / schematic: curve shapes and the split between phases are drawn, not measured; the time axis is a composite of two bench experiments; canal gap exaggerated; no y-scale

caption:
Warm gutta-percha: when does it stop shrinking?

Cooling 75→37 °C, backfill GP shrank 1.0–2.3 % (linear) within 10 min. In one 1997 dilatometer study, GP held at 37 °C kept shrinking for 45 min–10 h, then was stable through the 24-h hold. Past 24 h I found no data.
Bench data on free GP, not canals. In vitro, compacting warm GP more than made up for the shrinkage, and GP without sealer leaked more at 48 h.

Refs: Lottanti 2014 & Lee 1997, J Endod; Marlin 1971 thesis (publ. OOO 1973); Wu 2000, Int Endod J.
